```{r, message=FALSE}

rm(list=ls())
library(data.table)   # fread
library(ggplot2)
library(DT)          # datatable output
library(scales)
library(lme4)
library(MuMIn)
library(plotly)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

md_csv = "drosophila_predictions.csv"
metadata <- fread(md_csv)
#filter for high confidence detections!
metadata = metadata[conf > 0.90]

metadata[, DRYMASS_MG_PRED := (BF_PRED*ROI_SIZE_MM)^3 ]
metadata[, cbrDRYMASS_MG_PRED := DRYMASS_MG_PRED^ (1/3)]
metadata[, sqrtAREA_MM := AREA_MM2^(1/2)]


metadata <- metadata %>%
  separate(
    custom_label,
    into = c("ignore", "replicate", "species", "temp", "sex"),
    sep = "_",
    remove = FALSE
  ) %>%
  select(-ignore)

metadata <- metadata %>%
  mutate(
    temp = factor(temp, levels = c("19", "28"), ordered = TRUE)
  )
metadata <- as.data.table(metadata)

```

```{r}

## =========================
## ANOVA ANALYSIS SECTION
## =========================

# Load needed packages
library(car)
library(emmeans)

# Ensure categorical variables are factors
metadata <- metadata %>%
  mutate(
    sex = factor(sex),
    species = factor(species),
    temp = factor(temp)
  )

# Set contrasts for Type III ANOVA
options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))

## ---- 1. Fit full factorial model ----
mod <- lm(DRYMASS_MG_PRED ~ sex * species * temp, data = metadata)

## ---- 2. Type III ANOVA ----
cat("\n=== TYPE III ANOVA (raw biomass) ===\n")
print(Anova(mod, type = 3))

## ---- 3. Model diagnostics ----
par(mfrow = c(2,2))
plot(mod)

## ---- 4. Log-transform model (recommended for biomass) ----
mod_log <- lm(log(DRYMASS_MG_PRED) ~ sex * species * temp, data = metadata)

cat("\n=== TYPE III ANOVA (log biomass) ===\n")
print(Anova(mod_log, type = 3))

## Diagnostics for log model
par(mfrow = c(2,2))
plot(mod_log)

## ---- 5. Post-hoc comparisons ----
cat("\n=== POST-HOC (temperature within species & sex) ===\n")
emm <- emmeans(mod_log, ~ temp | species * sex)
print(pairs(emm))

## ---- 6. Optional: interaction means ----
cat("\n=== Estimated marginal means ===\n")
print(emmeans(mod_log, ~ sex * species * temp))


```
